title: IoU rewards, MWER as REINFORCE, and a residual policy
brief: Score boxes with IoU and stop a box-spraying hack, show that the minimum word error rate gradient is REINFORCE over an N-best list, and estimate a residual policy's gradient.
hints: iou clips each width and height at zero, and returns 0 when the union is zero, so degenerate boxes never produce NaN.

detection_reward: overlaps = iou(pred[:, None, :], gt[None, :, :]) has shape (K, M). Take the max over predictions for each true box, average, then multiply by min(1, M / K) when length_penalty is true.
edit_distance keeps one row: prev = list(range(len(hyp) + 1)), and each new row starts with [i]. wer divides by the number of reference words.
mwer_loss is sum(p_hat * (errors - errors.mean())), with p_hat a softmax of the log-scores with the maximum subtracted. mwer_grad is p_hat * (errors - sum(p_hat * errors)).
reinforce_gradient: to_go = np.cumsum(rewards[:, ::-1], axis=1)[:, ::-1], and the leave-one-out baseline is (to_go.sum(0, keepdims=True) - to_go) / (n - 1).
